    lines.append("-" * 90)
    for r in filtered[-10:]:
        lines.append(f"{r['relation']:<45s} {r['gold']:>5d} {r['sft_f1']:>7.4f} {r['rsft_f1']:>8.4f} {r['gain']:>+7.4f}")
